_doc: The loop registry: every loop Ultrastable runs, as data. A system is autonomous if it has self-referential loops and the ability to close them, so each loop has a trigger, an owner, an SLA, a Definition of Done, two independent paths, a closing probe and a write-back target in this repository. `python3 -m foundation loops --verify` (a step in checks.yml) fails when a loop lacks any of them, when a workflow, role or process area has no loop, or when a loop's knowledge lives only outside the repository. `closes_by` is `system` or `gate:<owner card file>` (an identity-bound step with its default in effect). Changed only by a reviewed PR.

loops.summary: INTENT-YIELD-1: for a given unit of human input, what is the best unit of output. Each owner directive is one intent; its own probe passing, unrestated, after 30 days is one kept outcome. Restatements are charged to the original, a directive that is not holding becomes a Q-YIELD item closed by its own probe, and /yield publishes the verdicts. No counts, no person scored.
loops.trigger: daily workflow and on demand
loops.done: ops/intent-yield/state.json is under 50 hours old with no error, every broken directive has a Q-YIELD item, and /yield shows the same verdicts

paths.how: .github/workflows/intent-yield.yml runs python3 -m foundation intentyield --run --apply
python3 -m foundation intentyield --run --apply from a cloud-hosted agent session

loops.summary: SEED-LAUNCH-1: every seed is built, deployed, year-gated and probed live by the system. A fresh seed from seed/ and every repository made from the seed template are launched on Ultrastable's own Cloudflare account; the year-unattended gate and a live /health probe are required.
loops.trigger: weekly workflow and on demand
loops.done: the latest e2e row in ops/seed-launches.jsonl passed and is under 8 days old, and no seeded repository's latest launch failed

paths.how: .github/workflows/seed-launch.yml runs python3 -m foundation seedlaunch --e2e --fleet
python3 -m foundation seedlaunch --e2e --fleet from a cloud-hosted agent session with the Cloudflare binding

loops.summary: IMPROVE-1: files reach, impact and plus work every pass, escalates stalled manager tiers, settles each change on its metric.
loops.trigger: daily product-manager workflow
loops.done: ops/improve/status.json is younger than a day and every filed item carries a prediction and probe

paths.how: python3 -m foundation improve --run --apply in .github/workflows/product-manager.yml
the same command run by a cloud-hosted agent session from the repository

loops.summary: FINDABLE-1: every fleet property is read daily for search and AI discoverability by open standards (robots, sitemap, llms.txt, meta description, canonical, Open Graph, schema.org JSON-LD, feed); gaps become one Q-FIND item per property and each feed is pinged to the open WebSub hub.
loops.trigger: daily workflow and on demand
loops.done: ops/findable.json is under 2 days old and every property with gaps has an open Q-FIND item; a property with none has its item closed

paths.how: .github/workflows/findable.yml runs python3 -m foundation findable --apply --ping
python3 -m foundation findable --apply --ping from a cloud-hosted agent session

loops.summary: LEDGER-KEYLESS-1: OpenAlex refuses the Replication Ledger Worker (Cloudflare egress, no API key). A GitHub runner asks OpenAlex the beat's own questions for every finding and its discovery searches, lands the answers as instances/replication-ledger/worker/data/openalex.json, and redeploys the Worker, whose beat reads them as a route through the same verbatim-quote guard; in between, the beat's keyless routes (Europe PMC, Crossref, Semantic Scholar) answer.
loops.trigger: daily workflow ledger-openalex.yml and on demand
loops.done: GET https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/health shows openalex_mirror.generated_at equal to the generated_at of data/openalex.json on main, and findings above 0

paths.how: .github/workflows/ledger-openalex.yml runs node instances/replication-ledger/worker/openalex-mirror.mjs and lands the file with scripts/land_data.py
the Worker's hourly beat reads Europe PMC, Crossref and Semantic Scholar with no key (instances/replication-ledger/worker/keyless.js) when OpenAlex refuses and the mirror holds no candidates

loops.closing_probe: grep:instances/replication-ledger/worker/keyless.test.mjs::the OpenAlex mirror a runner landed answers first

loops.summary: MANAGERS-1: every manager role is a running loop that owns code. One register (seed/autonomy/managers.json) says which managers a system runs; the tick hires every switched-on manager that has no runtime row, the check fails a role with no loop, code, clock or probe, and the live reading names managers that are missing or stopped.
loops.trigger: every change (checks.yml), every tick (reconcile step hires missing managers), every failure-audit pass (detector managers-live)
loops.done: python3 -m foundation managers --check passes and python3 -m foundation managers --live reads every switched-on manager as hired and ticking

paths.how: seed/worker/src/managers.js hireStep inside the tick's reconcile step on the runtime scheduler
.github/workflows/checks.yml runs python3 -m foundation managers --check; failure-audit.yml runs the detector managers-live

loops.summary: STANDARDS-1: OpenSSF Scorecard and the SPDX SBOM from GitHub's dependency graph are read weekly; each check under the floor and each package outside the licence policy becomes a Q-STD-SC-* item closed by the next reading. The reading itself is written to ops/supply-chain.json by the first run.
loops.trigger: weekly (supply-chain.yml) and on demand
loops.done: python3 -m foundation supplychain --check reports ok

paths.how: supply-chain.yml: scorecard-action, dependency-graph SBOM, python3 -m foundation supplychain --ingest scorecard.json sbom.json --apply
python3 -m foundation supplychain --ingest SC SBOM --apply from a cloud-hosted agent session with the two documents

loops.summary: ROLE-DUTIES-1: the qa engineer duty `unverified-done`: closed work is really verified: every item closed in the last 24 hours has a verified outcome from an independent probe (human analogue: QA or test engineer).
loops.trigger: hourly inside the tick step role_duties of ultrastable-tick
loops.done: a role_beats row for qa-engineer in the last hour, and no open QA-UNVERIFIED-* item while the reading is in bounds

paths.how: tick step role_duties (seed/worker/src/roleduties.js) on the Worker cron
node --test seed/worker/test/roleduties.test.js and the same query run from a cloud session

loops.last_plus: the reading is stored each hour in role_beats so the next run is comparable
